name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 6 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 39 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-01-05, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.94 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
